description:
Incorporated in 1959, PTL Enterprises Ltd provides manufactuing facility on lease basis [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] [3] [4] PTL, a subsidiary of Apollo Tyres Ltd (ATL), and its holding company is Sunrays Properties & Investment Co. Pvt Ltd . It leases its tire manufacturing facility to ATL under a fixed-income lease rental agreement. PTL produces truck-bus cross-ply tires, branded as Apollo, which are primarily distributed by ATL. ATL also markets products under the Apollo and Vredestein brands, with plans to expand into ASEAN and North America.
